description:
ZipRecruiter jobs (United States and Canada): job search with filters, full job details, and ZipRecruiter's salary estimates for a job title.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search (required: query): Search Jobs
- job_details (required: job_id): Job Details
- estimated_salary (required: job_title): Estimated Salary

When to use: Use for ZipRecruiter jobs specifically. For jobs across all sites use jsearch.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_ziprecruiter_data
